segment_contamination_dimensions: Permanent prefabricated industrial or commercial buildings (buyers seeking long-term fixed structures without relocation intent — served by siblings Prefabricated Buildings, Prefabricated Industrial Buildings, Prefabricated Steel Buildings, Pre Engineered Building Structure): names must not imply permanence or fixed-foundation construction.

Specialised agricultural enclosures (buyers seeking greenhouse, polyhouse, or controlled-environment growing structures — served by siblings Greenhouse, Agricultural Greenhouses, Polyhouse, Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse, Mini Greenhouse): names must not reference horticultural or crop-growing contexts.

Permanent labour colony with RCC construction (buyers seeking brick-and-mortar or RCC permanent worker quarters — served by sibling RCC Labour Quarter): names must not imply permanent civil construction or RCC framing.

Tensile and membrane structures (buyers seeking fabric-covered tensile canopies or event tensile structures as a distinct product — served by siblings Tensile Structures, Modular Tensile Structure, Tensile Membrane Structures, Auditorium Tensile Structure, Gazebo Tensile Structure): names must not be dominated by tensile or membrane fabric framing language.

Permanent prefabricated warehouses and storage buildings (buyers seeking large-span permanent storage facilities — served by siblings Prefabricated Warehouse, Storage Buildings): names must not imply permanent large-span warehouse construction.
